lead: We design and build gardens and grounds: plot zoning, paths, terraces, seating areas, lighting and planting. The garden becomes an extension of the house.
about: A garden planned together with the house

Landscaping works best when it is planned at the same time as the house: windows face the right views, the terrace is on the right side and utilities do not have to be dug up again. We handle architecture, interior and landscape as one team.
steps: We assess the terrain, soil and existing planting.
You see the plot before work begins.
faq: How much does landscape design cost?
It depends on the size of the plot and the scope: from $50 per 100 m² of plot. We give the exact price after a site visit.
Do you build the garden, not just design it?
Yes, we design and implement turnkey.
Can it be combined with building a house?
Yes, we design the landscape together with the architecture of the house.
